programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: 1969. Comedy/Drama. Directed by Carl Reiner. Stars Dick Van Dyke, Michele Lee And Mickey Rooney. The intriguing story of an exceptional silent-film comic whose talent is overshadowed by his ego. [S]

programme.title: Talking Pictures With Anita Harris
programme.desc: Anita Harris discusses her love of film, theatre And music. What working with the 'Carry On Team' was like And her memories of Harry Secombe, Frankie Howerd And Phil Silvers. Presented by Robert Ross.

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Billy Wilder, From Greta Garbo's Ninotchka, film noir classic Double Indemnity to his academy award winning classics Lost Weekend, Sunset Boulevard and The Apartment. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Devil's Fingers. 1966. Stars Adam West, Liberace And Marilyn Hanold. Batman and Robin must stop a nefarious concert pianist who's plotting to kill Bruce and marry Aunt Harriet. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Dead Ringers. 1966. Stars Adam West, Liberace And Burt Ward. Batman and Robin escape Chandell's trap and plot to outsmart him and put a stop to his malicious plan. [S]

programme.title: Third Party Risk
programme.desc: 1955. Crime. Directed by Daniel Birt. Stars Lloyd Bridges, Finlay Currie And Maureen Swanson. A man holidaying in Spain becomes inadvertently mixed up in a case of murder and microfilm smuggling. [S]

programme.title: Impulse (1955)
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Directed by Charles De la Tour And Cy Endfield. Stars Arthur Kennedy, Constance Smith And Joy Shelton. A night club singer tricks an estate agent into thinking he killed a jewel thief. [S]

programme.title: Hammer The Toff
programme.desc: 1952. Crime Drama by Maclean Rogers. The Toff (John Bentley) tries to help Susan (Patricia Dainton) reunite with her uncle who's been targeted by criminals that are after his steel formula. [S]

programme.title: Great Day In The Morning
programme.desc: 1956. Western. A gambler wins a hotel in a card game but finds himself involved with women and the start of the civil war. Starring Robert Stack, Virginia Mayo And Ruth Roman. [S]

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: Let The Chips Fall
programme.desc: ...Chips Fall. 1955. Stars Charles Boyer, Rhys Williams And Jean Willes. A reformed card sharp is enlisted to unmask a suspected poker cheat among a group of wealthy gamblers. [S]

programme.title: The Buccaneers
programme.desc: The Decoy. 1957. Stars Robert Shaw, Virginia Maskell And Marne Maitland. Whilst Tempest sails to Charleston, he encounters a strange woman alone in a boat at sea who tells him a peculiar story. [S]

programme.title: Doctor In Distress
programme.desc: 1963. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, James Robertson Justice And Samantha Eggar. Dr. Simon Sparrow's love life improves when the lovely Delia Mallory is brought into casualty. [S]

programme.title: Four Star Playhouse: The Lost Silk Hat
programme.desc: ...Silk Hat. 1952. Stars Ronald Colman, Richard Whorf And Jay Novello. After a lovers' quarrel and a vow to never return, a man realises he has left behind his silk hat. How will he retrieve it? [S]

programme.title: What's On TPTV With Noel
programme.desc: Founder of Talking Pictures TV and one half of the Footage Detectives, Noel Cronin, shares shows and films not to be missed throughout November. [S]

programme.title: Scandal Sheet (1952)
programme.desc: 1952. Crime. Directed by Phil Karlson. Stars John Derek, Donna Reed And Broderick Crawford. A newspaper editor accidentally kills his ex-wife and his protégé is assigned to investigate the story. [S]

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Miss Peebles and Mr Busby Pt1. Stars Graham Crowden, Anne Stallybrass and Sylvia Kay. Mr Busby, an eccentric elderly tenant, is accused of stealing from Miss Peebles. [S]

programme.title: Rooms
programme.desc: Miss Peebles and Mr Busby Pt2. Stars Graham Crowden, Anne Stallybrass and Sylvia Kay. Miss Peebles patience wears thin with Mr Busby upstairs. [S]

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: The Shooting Master. 1986. Lock, stock and barrel Jack explains the working of his great-grandfather's shotgun. Then he visits a shooting school on a disused railway line. [S]

programme.title: Dick Turpin
programme.desc: The Hero. 1979. Stars Richard O'Sullivan, Kevin Brennan, David Daker. Dick takes pity on an unimpressive suitor, when the wealthy Phyllida is arranged to marry, helping to unite the young lovers. [S]

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: The Rainbow Ends Here. Stars Barry Foster, Michael Latimer And Susan Travers. Van der Valk searches for a teenage girl abducted on her way to a clandestine rendezvous with a married man. [S]

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes: Murder by Decree
programme.desc: 1979. Crime. Director: Bob Clark. Stars: Christopher Plummer, James Mason And David Hemmings. Holmes investigates Jack the Ripper's murders and discovers a conspiracy to protect the killer. [S]

programme.title: The Appointment
programme.desc: 1981. Horror. Director: Lindsey C. Vickers. Stars Edward Woodward, Jane Merrow And Samantha Weysom. Ian misses his daughter's concert so he will have to contend with more than just childish sulking. [S]

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: 1946. Drama. Director: Lewis Milestone. Stars Barbara Stanwyck, Van Heflin, Lizabeth Scott And Kirk Douglas. The relationships formed in childhood by three friends lead to murder and obsessive love. [S]

programme.title: Look At Life The Village Sleeps Again
programme.desc: 1962. A look at the arguments for and against building by-passes, featuring Transport Minister Ernest Marples. With a look at the by-passes being built and the effects on small towns and villages.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: The Renegades. Wayne Rogers And Robert Bray run a stagecoach line in the Old West, where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Hizzonner the Penguin. 1966. Stars Adam West And Burgess Meredith. Suspiciously endearing himself to the citizens of Gotham by foiling a robbery, the Penguin announces he is running for mayor. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Dizzonner the Penguin. 1966. Stars Adam West, Burgess Meredith And Woodrow Parfrey. The Penguin kidnaps members of the election board in an attempt to sway the votes to become mayor in his favour. [S]

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Alfred Hitchcock defined his own unique style of filmmaking from the early days of the 39 Steps and the Lodger to the Hollywood glamour of North by Northwest. [S]

programme.title: Stock Car
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. After the death of her father while motor racing, the daughter (Rona Anderson) is dissuaded from selling his garage by fellow racer Larry (Paul Carpenter) who helps her run it. [S]

programme.title: Liz Fraser
programme.desc: Desert Mice. Talking Pictures was fortunate to film with Liz Fraser and discuss her life in film a few years ago. Here she talks exclusively to Robert Ross.

programme.title: Desert Mice
programme.desc: 1959. Comedy. Set in WW2, this is the story of an ENSA troupe of entertainers. Starring Sid James, Dora Bryan, Alfred Marks and Liz Fraser. [S]

programme.title: Love In Pawn
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Penniless couple Roger (Bernard Braden) and Jean (Barbara Kelly) will get £10,000 if Roger can live a sober and profitable life. Starring Reg Dixon and John Laurie. [S]

programme.title: So Long at the Fair
programme.desc: 1950. Mystery. Directors: Antony Darnborough And Terence Fisher. Stars Jean Simmons And Dirk Bogarde. Two siblings visit Paris for the Great Exhibition of 1889 when one of them goes missing. [S]

programme.title: The Duchess of Duke Street
programme.desc: One Night's Grace. 1976. Stars Gemma Jones, Christopher Cazenove And Sally Osborne. Everyone is intrigued when an attractive young lady asks to see Lord Haslemere. Who is she and what is she after? [S]

programme.title: The End of the Affair
programme.desc: 1955. Drama. Director: Edward Dmytryk. Stars Deborah Kerr, Van Johnson And John Mills. In WW2 London, a writer falls in love with the wife of a civil servant. Both men suspect her of infidelity. [S]

programme.title: Whispering Smith Hits London
programme.desc: 1952. Mystery. Director: Francis Searle. Stars Richard Carlson, Greta Gynt And Herbert Lom. US sleuth Whispering Smith arrives in London on holiday but soon becomes embroiled in a murder case. [S]

programme.title: Weir's Way
programme.desc: An Edinburgh Volcano. 1981. Tom visits Arthur's Seat in Edinburgh, the most studied volcano in the world and where the very beginnings of geology were laid by Edinburgh geologist James Hutton. [S]

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: The Guilt Beneath the Gingerbread. 1974. Stars Richard Easton, Bill Treacher And Timothy Carlton. Brian finds himself alone to answer police questioning. Meanwhile, unrest at the depot continues. [S]

programme.title: Mark Saber
programme.desc: Man About To Die. 1958. Stars Donald Gray And Neil McCallum. The hero of a children's sci-fi programme on television is a man without enemies, or so he thinks until someone threatens his life. [S]

programme.title: The Wheeltappers and Shunters Social Club
programme.desc: ...Social Club. Episode 25. 1975. Julie Rogers performs 'My World Gets Smaller Every Day', and Wild Honey perform 'I Can't Leave You Alone'. Plus, Dustin Gee, Ronnie Dukes and Ricki Lee star. [S]

programme.title: Lord Jim
programme.desc: 1965. Adventure. Directed by Richard Brooks. Stars James Mason, Peter O'Toole And Curt Jurgens. A discredited seaman, desperately seeking to redeem himself, agrees to deliver a dangerous shipment. [S]

programme.title: Up The Chastity Belt
programme.desc: 1971. Comedy. Director: Bob Kellett. Stars: Frankie Howerd, Eartha Kitt, Anna Quayle, Roy Hudd. Lurkalot is a serf who sells chastity belts and love potions at the local market place. [S]

programme.title: A Home of Your Own
programme.desc: 1965. Comedy. Directed by Jay Lewis Stars Ronnie Barker, Peter Butterworth And Bernard Cribbins. A wordless, satirical look at British builders as they attempt to build a young couple's dream home.

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Knotted Scarf. 1963. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt And Brewster Mason. A woman is found dead, strangled with a knotted scarf. Leaving behind a husband some 26 years her senior. [S]

programme.title: Burke's Law
programme.desc: Who Killed Rosie Sunset? 1965. Stars Gene Barry, Gary Conway And Regis Toomey. A nice old lady has been murdered. Who and why would do such thing. She only sold maps of stars homes.

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: Batman

programme.title: The Secret Man
programme.desc: 1958. Thriller. Director: Ronald Kinnoch. Stars Marshall Thompson, John Loder And Henry Oscar. A physicist finds himself drawn into an investigation to track down a spy at his research station. [S]

programme.title: Life In Emergency Ward 10
programme.desc: 1959. Drama. Based on the smash hit TV series about the daily life and the ups and downs of a hospital. Stars Michael Craig, Wilfred Hyde-White and Joan Sims. [S]

programme.title: Railway Murders
programme.desc: The Guardsman. 2021. Stars Nicholas Day, Judith Rowbotham And Alan Moss. 28 year old Geoffrey Charles Dean was murdered by a railway fireman who stole £160 from the railway booking office. [S]
